newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine moves against corporate corruption.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine moves against corporate corruption.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma moved on Monday to stop businesses passing themselves off as charities to import goods without paying customs duties.
He signed a law cancelling tax breaks on goods brought into the country by charitable groups including humanitarian aid and technical assistance organisations.
The law, adopted earlier this month by parliament, was made public at the weekend and will take effect in January.
The move is part of Ukraine's attempts to pay off the country's $1.6 billion wage debt and to halt corruption.
Citizens retain the right to import up to $1,400 in goods without being charged duty.
